title: Qualification report (Stage 2)
description: The qualification report produced after Stage 1. Binds only input-identity.sha256 (never itself or later stages). Owned/implemented by Todo 37. Todo 1 shipped this as a restrictive stub; Todo 37 froze it by adding the one normative fact the report must carry and the stub had nowhere to put: `producer`, because the plan requires the five qualification paths to declare `produce-qualification` and its bound binary hash as producer and makes missing/mismatched producer provenance an F1 REJECT rather than an assumption. Nothing was removed or relaxed: every stub field stays required and `additionalProperties` stays false.

producer.description: Which binary emitted this document. Exactly the Todo-37-owned producer; never Todo 35's harness, which emits no final artifact.
